north_star: The owners always know what the dog is doing and can see her, without stressing her, on a $5 server.

goals.metric: minutes the oldest unanswered report has waited

goals.what: Fewer things go wrong for the owners
Find <pet> finds her when she is home
goals.metric: share of searches that found her, among searches with nearby visual evidence, excluding owner-cancelled searches
goals.ground_truth: search events plus at least two detections in the defined nearby windows (definition v2); a proxy, not independent at-home ground truth

goals.metric: median seconds from a search starting to 'found her', last 24 h
goals.ground_truth: search events and records (/var/lib/petcam/searches); owner asked 2026-11-03

goals.what: Follow keeps her in view after seeing her
goals.metric: time-weighted detector visibility during logged Follow intervals within 30 min of a sighting, last 24 h
goals.ground_truth: obs score/box and track rows; detector-derived proxy, not independently labeled at-home time
goals.note: Owner request 2026-11-05. Provisional 80% operational target. Excludes disabled Follow and long telemetry gaps. Does not authorize extra movement; motor/rest guards remain in force.

goals.metric: % of one core used by the camera services, last hour

goals.what: CPU credits banked for live view and searches

goals.metric: seconds since the watcher last published, sampled each collect
goals.note: Owner request from 2026-11-03 restored during the full request audit. This is a target, not an achieved result. Publication age is separate from source frame and detector age; do not refresh timestamps without new evidence to claim success.

goals.what: Opening the app shows her live within a second
goals.metric: seconds from page load to the first video playing event: median and 90th percentile over 7 days, assessed only with at least 5 recorded page openings; connection timings are separate diagnostics
goals.ground_truth: the app's live_first_frame events with open_ms (/api/usage), with sample counts, source observation times and separate startup-timeout/reconnect counts
goals.note: Median <= 1 s and p90 <= 2 s are continuous performance targets. Percentiles describe successful page-load starts; failed starts and foreground resumes are not silently counted as fast successes. Startup timeout/reconnect counts are context, not a measured success rate. Missing or stale page-open samples cannot establish healthy startup. Controlled unloaded and foreground-resume measurements remain agent work.

goals.what: A finished fix ships within a day
goals.metric: hours the oldest queued fix (eval/superagent/queued_*.json) has waited, sampled each collect
goals.ground_truth: the queue files on the agent's computer
goals.note: 2026-11-04: 17 fixes had queued since 11-03 and none was retried: the checkout was never clean because the nightly job rewrote a tracked file (agent/lessons.md)
